newsitem.title: USA: NTN gets FCC approval for keypad.
newsitem.headline: NTN gets FCC approval for keypad.

text.p: NTN Communications Inc said the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has granted approval to NTN for its Playmaker keypad.

This approval covers both a completely new Playmaker design ready for immediate release, and also includes such existing devices currently used in conjunction with NTN's satellite broadcasts of interactive games, trivia and polling services to hospitality locations throughout North America.

NTN said it will start shipping Playmakers to existing backlog of 290 new client sites immediately. The application process did not interrupt services to subscribers on the NTN Entertainment Network, or affect NTN's on-line or Internet programming.
